SELECT json_build_object(
  'fn_novo', (SELECT pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) LIKE '%uc.user_id = NEW.assigned_to%' AND pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) LIKE '%auth.uid()%' FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.proname = 'fn_notify_task_assigned' LIMIT 1),
  'gatilho', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('evento', event_manipulation, 'quando', action_timing)) FROM information_schema.triggers WHERE event_object_table = 'company_tasks' AND trigger_name = 'trg_notify_task_assigned'),
  'gatilho_def', (SELECT pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) FROM pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgname = 'trg_notify_task_assigned' LIMIT 1)
) AS r
